title: Plasma Forge
description: The &3Plasma Forge&r is a large and advanced assembler that requires a running fusion reactor to work. It can weld plates at twice the speed of a normal welder. It does not accept upgrades, however, it can use up otherwise useless fission fragments and unstable isotopes to gain a temporary &ex4&r speed bonus with no penalty.
Plasma Forges pass on 75% of the thermal energy, meaning that with a simple Deuterium - Oxygen fusion reactor, up to 4 can be chained for welding purposes.
&2With 3MTU/t plasma energy input, one can make pre-assembled fusion reactors with a discount.&r&r
